Method of Attack: Hides in legitimate WordPress files to add a secret admin user and grant attackers control over infected sites
Injected malicious code into WordPress core files such as functions.php and class.wp.php
Injected malicious code inside legitimate files of old WordPress default themes (twentyfifteen and twentysixteen)
Created a new admin user named 100010010 as a backdoor account to open connection for scripted attacks
Leveraged vulnerabilities in outdated plugins and themes to upload malware
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in outdated plugins and themes
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious code in twentyfifteen and twentysixteen theme files
